lede: Interior Secretary Douglas J. Burgum disclosed six new trades dated April 8, 2026, the largest a purchase of Nucleus Security, Inc. through Arthur Ventures Growth IV, LP valued at $100,001 to $250,000. The remaining transactions, including purchases in zizzl Health, Hudu Technologies, Inc. and a second Nucleus Security stake, along with sales of Decimal Technologies, Inc., each fell in the $1,001 to $15,000 range. Across all filings tracked by Open Cabinet, Burgum has reported 153 transactions, 106 of which he certified as filed late.
